name: Test Chamber
description: This is a Portal-inspired map. There are many portal-like gimmicks in this map. Aerial Faith Plate - Visually is a stone pressure plate in front of magenta glazed terracotta; the arrow points to the direction you'll be launched and the target is the landing position. Tractor Beam - Visually represented with light blue glass display entities; it causes you to float and pushes you from the lime concrete to the red concrete. Propulsion (Orange) Gel - Represented by orange carpet; grants speed to the player. Repulsion (Blue) Gel - Represented by light blue carpet; grants jump boost to the player and is bouncy. Portal - Blue portal teleports you to orange portal. Fall Damage is disabled in this map.
